description: Ask a question about what is on a browser tab. Deputy reads the page itself and returns a short answer. Use this instead of screenshotting or dumping the DOM — the page never enters your context, so a lookup costs a couple of hundred tokens rather than tens of thousands. Without a model, it returns the passages relevant to your question instead.

question.description: What you want to know, e.g. "what is the cheapest result?"

tabId.description: Tab to read. Defaults to the active tab.

name: browser_ask
title: Ask about a page instead of looking at it
